recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆單獨的漿細胞樣細胞：核圓略偏位、染色質塊狀，細胞質量中等、呈顆粒狀藍紫色；背景散在血小板。單一細胞無法確定是否為漿細胞白血病，需計數與流式確認。
features: Single circulating cell of small-to-medium size
Round, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
Moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm with a finely granular texture
No distinct perinuclear hof clearly resolved
Background normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single small-to-medium cell with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm; a perinuclear hof is not clearly resolved. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. The cell is compatible with a circulating plasma cell, but a single cell cannot distinguish plasma cell leukemia from a plasmacytoid lymphocyte; quantification of circulating plasma cells and flow cytometry for a clonal CD38+/CD138+ population are needed.

ddx.vs: Has a more central nucleus and less abundant cytoplasm without a Golgi hof; flow cytometry shows CD19/CD20 expression rather than a CD138+ phenotype.
Morphologically identical as a single cell; distinguished by polytypic light-chain expression and low numbers.
An early erythroid precursor has a central round nucleus with finer chromatin and deeply blue agranular cytoplasm, and usually occurs with other nucleated red cells.
